sources.title: Multigrid Reduction (MGR), hypre documentation
sources.finding: MGR uses a prescribed C/F split, F relaxation and coarse correction for coupled variable systems.
sources.notEstablished: No claim that installing or reproducing MGR has solved the current rocket system.

sources.title: PCAIR, PETSc documentation
sources.readScope: Official manual page, including required PFLARE dependency and available nonsymmetric reduction approaches
sources.finding: AIR is a reduction-based family for nonsymmetric systems; concrete interpolation, smoothing and C/F choices matter.
sources.notEstablished: No PETSc, PFLARE or hypre installation or integration was performed.

sources.title: Nonsymmetric Algebraic Multigrid Based on Local Approximate Ideal Restriction (lAIR)
sources.readScope: Author metadata and abstract only; full paper not checked
sources.finding: Local approximate ideal restriction with F relaxation is motivated by nonsymmetric advection-diffusion-reaction systems.
sources.notEstablished: The current group-constant V-cycle and proposed local spatial Schur prototype are not claimed to reproduce lAIR or its reported convergence.

currentImplementationIdentity: Own unsmoothed block aggregation prototype, tested and unsuccessful for the real same-Q 32-step target
nextCandidateIdentity: Own spatial C/F local-elimination candidate, topology/resource preflight only
